_doc: Hồng Đậu Trang's Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Input to tools/design/combat_sim/put_effects.py under source world-depth:hong_dau. Unpriced. Rule text from design/world/depth/sects/hong_dau.items.json.

Half of a Pair.rule: Phi Hồng, Flying Red: while Tàn Hồng is not held by the same person, this sword's crit chance (+8 % [sword]) counts only against a foe carrying your Wood stacks. Held together with Tàn Hồng, each crit with either sword scatters a petal that gives the foe one Wood stack (Tàn Hồng is lost in slot V-1).
Half of a Pair.approx: Tàn Hồng is not in the game yet, so only the un-paired half runs: -8 crit [sword] while the foe carries 0 Wood stacks.

The Second Cup Is Poured.rule: Fan of the Gracious Door: after 20 seconds in the fight, the foe takes 10 % more damage from your Wood poisons and Charmed lasts 1 pulse longer on them.
The Second Cup Is Poured.approx: Wood poison ticks do not read live damage modifiers, so the +10 % poison damage after 20 s runs as a 10 % Soul return_damage rider on each Wood tick_dealt.

The Second Cup.rule: Tea at the Manor, full set (2 pieces): once per foe each fight, when the foe carries eight or more of your Wood Poison stacks, they drink the second cup: they are Charmed (2 s), their Wood Poison batches refresh, and they gain 2 Heavy Breath (4 s).
The Second Cup.approx: Reads Wood debuff stacks (foe.debuff.wood >= 8) rather than batch count, and refreshes Wood debuff batches to full duration instead of pausing their countdown for 3 s.

Planted, Waited, Harvested.rule: The Back Garden, full set (3 pieces): once Wood Poison has lasted 6 s on the foe, your Wood Poison grants double-stack (+1 stack per grant). Once a fight when a Wood art (other than Gather More) lands on a foe with 6+ Wood stacks after 6 s of poison, you harvest all Wood stacks for immediate Chaos damage (0.15 per stack) and heal 0.5 % max health per stack.
Planted, Waited, Harvested.approx: Tracks elapsed seconds of Wood Poison on the foe (garden_ripe_t >= 6) rather than per-batch age, doubles single-stack grants via stack_grant +1 [wood, debuff], and fires the one-time harvest on a Wood art hit.
